assets.title: Scout Torso (Mech Robots and Battle Hangar)
assets.description: Light scout-frame torso: slim angled chest, sensor visor strip, narrow yoke with rear-swept fins. Dimensions 2.35 by 1.62 by 0.79 m (X by Y by Z). Origin at the ground centre; metres, +Y up, +Z forward. Weight class light: 0.4 m socket pads. Connectors: shoulder-left (socket-arm) at -0.80, 0.95, 0.00 facing 0, -1, 0; shoulder-right (socket-arm) at 0.80, 0.95, 0.00 facing 0, -1, 0; hip (socket-legs) at 0.00, 0.00, 0.00 facing 0, -1, 0; head (socket-head) at 0.00, 1.25, 0.00 facing 0, 1, 0; back (socket-back) at 0.00, 0.65, -0.40 facing 0, 0, -1. Frame palette: gunmetal, olive and orange accent, flat shaded. Static geometry; no rig, collision or navigation data. Original design.

assets.title: Rover 4wd (Robots and Drones Kit)
assets.description: Four wheel drive field rover with rocker suspension arms, a solar deck and a nodding sensor mast. Dimensions 0.77 by 1.14 by 1.01 m (X by Y by Z). Origin at the footprint centre, resting on y = 0; metres, +Y up, +Z forward. Named pivots: wheel-lr at (-0.32, 0.16, -0.35); wheel-lf at (-0.32, 0.16, 0.35); wheel-rr at (0.32, 0.16, -0.35); wheel-rf at (0.32, 0.16, 0.35); sensor-mast at (-0.15, 1.02, -0.3). Rigid node-transform clips: wheel-roll and tilt. No skinning. No collision or navigation data. Wheels roll and the sensor head nods. Suspension arms are static. Original design for the robots and drones kit.

assets.title: Duck Spring Rocker (City Park and Playground)
assets.description: The same spring and plate carrying a yellow duck body with a flat bill and a stub tail, for a second animal on the same play area. The spring coil is modelled solid and does not deform; the rocking is the body node above it. Overall 0.600 x 1.120 x 1.270 m (X x Y x Z), metre units, +Y up, +Z forward, resting on y=0. Named nodes on their own pivots: rocker. Functional variant of spring-rocker. City Park and Playground / citypark-lp-v1: faceted turf and paving, timber, galvanised steel and three playground accents, with embedded procedural concrete and timber maps and no custom shaders. Rigid node-transform clips: rock. No skinning. No collision or navigation data.
